div.p:
PRODUCERS APPEND WORK TO A BOUNDED QUEUE; CONSUMERS DRAIN IT AT
THEIR OWN RATE. THE QUEUE DECOUPLES THE TWO IN TIME, ABSORBS
BURSTS, AND MAKES BACK-PRESSURE EXPLICIT.

ul.li:
SD-NOTES/TOOLS/ASYNCHRONISM.D2 — THE MESSAGE QUEUE PLUS THE
RATE LIMITER, BUFFER MANAGER, CIRCUIT BREAKER, AND LOAD SHEDDER
ARE ALL MECHANISMS FOR HANDLING A FULL OR SLOW QUEUE.
